displayDescription: Chinese ink wash on cool dawn xuan paper: one dry-brush stroke grows into a branch whose twigs and ink blooms connect into a system.
styleRenderer: Canvas 2D (seeded bristle-dab brush masks, baked blurred wash layers, stippled granular fill, baked xuan-paper fibre texture)
motionEngine: GSAP 3.15.0 local paused timeline at window.__timelines.video (sole owner of canvas state object and text opacity/blur)
limitations: Ink, paper absorption and bloom diffusion are procedural Canvas 2D approximations (seeded dabs, blur filters, radial gradients), not scanned ink assets or a fluid simulation.
STYLE.json tech.preview_recipes is empty; the refresh demonstrates the source-frame review's ink construction order instead of a named recipe.

Background moved from the prior warm swatch #F4EFDF to scene-dependent cool grey-white xuan paper #E7EAE7 (dawn mood); ink token #242724 preserved; the far wash uses a diluted cool blue-grey cast of the same ink.
Blender was not used, per user instruction. Rendering and browser QA are left to the host.
